title: الساعي
author: Youssef Emad
description:
This Arabic self-help book by Youssef Emad, The Striver (الساعي), is built around the idea that everyone needs to be a striver in every part of life.

Rather than simply waiting patiently for things to improve, the author argues, it is active effort that unlocks closed doors. It suits readers looking for motivation and encouragement to keep working towards their goals.

  • Author: Youssef Emad
  • Publisher: Deer Publishing and Distribution
  • Format: Paperback, 127 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9789778542554

title: يؤتكم خيرًا مما أخذ منكم
author: Ahmed Al-Sabouni
description:
This Arabic book by Ahmed Al-Sabouni, He Will Give You Better Than What Was Taken from You (يؤتكم خيرًا مما أخذ منكم), takes its title from a Qur'anic verse and offers reflections for anyone coping with loss. Its starting point is the idea that a single moment of loss can teach us more than abundance ever could.

The author encourages readers not to take blessings for granted or judge events by appearances, suggesting that what is withheld may itself be a mercy and that God's choice for us is always good. More than a book of consolation, it shows how loss can become a new beginning. It suits readers seeking comfort and spiritual reflection.

  • Author: Ahmed Al-Sabouni
  • Publisher: Aseer Al-Kotob
  • Format: Paperback, 208 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9789779925554

title: طاغوت
author: Ahmed Khaled Mostafa
description:
This is an Arabic novel by Ahmed Khaled Mostafa, Taghut (طاغوت). It follows two children who walk towards the taghut, a false idol or tyrannical power, give it their souls and master sorcery to a degree no one else has reached.

Their paths then split dramatically: one sacrifices millions of lives to his idol and rises to become a modern son of Satan, while the other confronts and defeats his own taghut to become the greatest Sufi master in Europe, battling human and jinn tyrants along the way. Dark and dramatic, it suits readers of supernatural and occult thrillers.

  • Author: Ahmed Khaled Mostafa
  • Publisher: Aseer Al-Kotob
  • Format: Paperback, 376 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9789779925547

title: محاط بالمرضى النفسيين
author: Thomas Erikson
description:
This is the Arabic edition of Swedish behavioural expert Thomas Erikson's Surrounded by Psychopaths (محاط بالمرضى النفسيين), translated by Ahmed Hassan, a guide to protecting yourself from manipulation and exploitation. It follows on from Surrounded by Idiots, in which Erikson introduced his four-colour DISC model of behaviour.

Here he turns to the people who do not fit that model: those who lack empathy and remorse and manipulate others to serve their own ends. Erikson explains how to recognise the warning signs, how such people operate at work and in relationships, and which practical strategies help you defend yourself. It suits readers of popular psychology and anyone dealing with difficult people.

  • Author: Thomas Erikson
  • Translator: Ahmed Hassan
  • Publisher: Aseer Al-Kotob
  • Format: Paperback, 326 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • Series: Surrounded by Idiots
  • ISBN: 9789776902329

title: كيف تبيع أي شيء لأي إنسان
sheet_title: كيف تبيع أي شيء لأي إنسان
author: Joe Girard
description:
This is the Arabic edition of Joe Girard's How to Sell Anything to Anybody (كيف تبيع أي شيء لأي إنسان), translated by Ahmed Hassan. Girard, whom Guinness World Records recognised as the world's top salesman, sets out the methods that took him to the summit of his profession.

He shows how to work out what a customer wants and can afford, earn trust and referrals, use honesty to turn a refusal around, close a deal while making a friend, and treat complaints as a route to new orders. Practical and down to earth, it suits anyone in sales or customer service who wants to keep clients for life.

  • Author: Joe Girard
  • Translator: Ahmed Hassan
  • Publisher: Aseer Al-Kotob
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9789779923956

title: وكان النفاق جميلا
author: Khaled Ghattas
description:
And Hypocrisy Was Beautiful (وكان النفاق جميلا) is an Arabic collection of short philosophical novels and the first book by Khaled Ghattas. The pieces may seem unconnected at first, yet each one returns to the same subject: what it means to be human today.

The stories take on the social and personal dilemmas of modern life, from the loss of identity and an excess of rationalism to overexposure and dependence on technology, and the way these wear down love, hope, creativity, imagination and faith. Rather than offering answers, the author raises questions for the reader to think through, making this a good choice for lovers of reflective, idea-driven fiction.

  • Author: Khaled Ghattas
  • Publisher: Aseer Al-Kotob
  • Format: 144 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9789776972605

title: يوسف أيها الصديق
author: Kifah Abu Hnoud
description:
Joseph, O Man of Truth (يوسف أيها الصديق) is a reflective Arabic book by Kifah Abu Hnoud on the life of the Prophet Yusuf (Joseph), whose story the Qur'an calls the best of stories. Its title is taken from words addressed to Yusuf in the Qur'an itself.

The author reads Yusuf's life as a complete story in which every stage leads towards empowerment, and dwells on how he kept a careful balance between this world and the next while holding on to his dream. Written in a lyrical, devotional style, it suits readers who want to reflect more deeply on Surat Yusuf and the lessons of the prophets.

  • Author: Kifah Abu Hnoud
  • Publisher: Aseer Al-Kotob
  • Format: Paperback, 350 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9789779925585

title: الفرح
author: Dik Al-Jinn
description:
Joy (الفرح) is an Arabic book by the writer known as Dik Al-Jinn, published by Aseer Al-Kotob. Its blurb is an intense address to a beloved, asking how anyone could ever tire of gazing at a single photograph, and how such a spell might ever be broken.

It suits readers drawn to emotional Arabic writing about love and longing.

  • Author: Dik Al-Jinn
  • Publisher: Aseer Al-Kotob
  • Format: 368 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9789776902404

title: فهم الأمراض النفسية منطقيًا
author: Dean Burnett
description:
This is the Arabic edition of neuroscientist Dean Burnett's Psycho-Logical (فهم الأمراض النفسية منطقيًا), translated by Issa Abdullah. It asks why problems such as anxiety and depression affect so many people, why modern life seems to weigh so heavily on our minds, and why confusion and stigma still surround the subject.

Burnett explains what is actually going on inside the brain during anxiety, depression and addiction, pairing scientific research with first-hand accounts from people who live with these conditions every day. Honest, engaging and reassuring, it suits anyone who wants a clearer, kinder understanding of mental illness.

  • Author: Dean Burnett
  • Translator: Issa Abdullah
  • Publisher: Aseer Al-Kotob
  • Format: Paperback, 352 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9789776902633

title: ما لا يسع المسلم جهله
author: Nasser Sabra Al-Kiswani
description:
What No Muslim Should Be Ignorant Of (ما لا يسع المسلم جهله) is an Arabic introduction to the essentials of Islamic knowledge by Nasser Sabra Al-Kiswani, with an introduction by Kifah Abu Hnoud. It brings together sound belief, the core rulings of fiqh and the life of the Prophet Muhammad in a single volume.

Later chapters turn to character and ethics and to the Prophet's hadith, explaining how scholars tell authentic reports from weak ones. Aimed at building a solid general grounding in religious knowledge, it works well for beginners, study circles and anyone looking for a reliable first reference on their faith.

  • Author: Nasser Sabra Al-Kiswani
  • Introduction: Kifah Abu Hnoud
  • Publisher: Aseer Al-Kotob
  • Format: Paperback, 511 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9789779925042

title: بساتين عربستان
author: Osamah M. Al Muslim
description:
Gardens of Arabistan (بساتين عربستان) is an Arabic fantasy novel by the Saudi author Osamah M. Al Muslim, and the first book in his series of the same name. It is set in a distant age after the Pharaoh of Moses and the ring of Solomon, but before Jesus and the coming of Islam.

The author presents it as a tale that history never wrote down, passed from one storyteller to the next until he set it on paper. Blending dark fantasy, horror and magic, it is a substantial opening volume for readers who enjoy myth-rich Arabic storytelling.

  • Author: Osamah M. Al Muslim
  • Publisher: Arab Literature Center (Markaz Al-Adab Al-Arabi)
  • Format: Paperback, 535 pages
  • Language: Arabic
  • Series: Gardens of Arabistan, Book 1
  • ISBN: 9786030000005

title: Worldwide History of Dress - Arabic Edition
sheet_title: Worldwide History of Dress - Arabic Edition
author: Patricia Rieff Anawalt
description:
This is the Arabic edition of The Worldwide History of Dress by Patricia Rieff Anawalt, a sweeping illustrated survey of what people have worn across the globe, from prehistoric plant-fibre skirts and Egyptian linen to kimonos, saris, Tyrolean dirndls and the dress of the modern Middle East.

It spans every major region and period and every part of an outfit, from everyday garments, footwear and headwear to jewellery, armour, ceremonial costume and body adornment. With over a thousand illustrations, including photographs, museum pieces, historic artworks, drawings and maps made for the book, it is a rich reference for students, designers and anyone fascinated by fashion and culture.

  • Author: Patricia Rieff Anawalt
  • Publisher: Thames & Hudson
  • Format: Hardcover
  • Language: Arabic
  • ISBN: 9780500516065

title: Football Murals- A Celebration of soccer's greatest street art
sheet_title: Football Murals- A Celebration of soccer's greatest street art
author: Andy Brassell
description:
Football Murals: A Celebration of Soccer's Greatest Street Art by broadcaster and football journalist Andy Brassell is a richly illustrated tour of the giant painted tributes to the game's heroes. Found on tower blocks, stadium walls and street corners across the globe, they honour stars from Messi, Ronaldo and Salah to Cruyff, Beckenbauer and Megan Rapinoe.

Brassell explores what these murals mean to supporters, and how being painted on a wall ties a player to a club and its community. Offering a fresh, visual way into the world game, it makes a striking gift for football fans and lovers of street art alike.

  • Author: Andy Brassell
  • Publisher: Bloomsbury Sport
  • Format: Hardcover, 176 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781399402804

title: An Edited Life
author: Anna Newton
description:
An Edited Life: Simple Steps to Streamlining Your Life, at Work and at Home is Anna Newton's practical guide to decluttering, written for anyone who has started a big clear-out and given up halfway with a cupboard still in chaos.

Newton covers far more than your belongings, from your wardrobe and home to your phone and digital life, with advice on making a digital detox stick and building a capsule wardrobe that suits you rather than a formula. Realistic and encouraging rather than strict, it helps readers find the amount of stuff that is right for them and keep things tidy for the long term.

  • Author: Anna Newton
  • Publisher: Quadrille
  • Format: Hardcover, 256 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781787132429

title: Genocide in Gaza: Israel, Hamas, and the Long War on Palestine
sheet_title: Genocide in Gaza: Israel, Hamas, and the Long War on Palestine
author: Avi Shlaim
description:
Genocide in Gaza: Israel, Hamas, and the Long War on Palestine is a short, forceful work in which the historian Avi Shlaim examines how Israel has dealt with Gaza. Shlaim places the recent war within a longer history of repeated military assaults on the territory.

He argues that these recurring attacks flow from the logic of settler colonialism, and that the current war has gone beyond dispossession and ethnic cleansing to amount to genocide. Direct and uncompromising, it suits readers who want a leading historian's critical account of Gaza, Israel and Palestine.

  • Author: Avi Shlaim
  • Publisher: Irish Pages Press
  • Format: Hardcover, 160 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781739090227

title: P is for Palestine
author: Golbarg Bashi
description:
P is for Palestine: A Palestine Alphabet Book by Golbarg Bashi, illustrated by Golrokh Nafisi, is a children's ABC that introduces Palestine one letter at a time. Presented as the first English-language alphabet book about Palestine, it is told in simple, rhythmic rhyme.

Bright illustrations celebrate Palestinian culture, places, heritage and everyday life, with inspiration drawn from Palestinian writers and artists such as Ghassan Kanafani and Naji al-Ali. Colourful and empowering, it is a lovely way to share Palestine's story with young children and a meaningful book for families to read together.

  • Author: Golbarg Bashi
  • Illustrator: Golrokh Nafisi
  • Publisher: Dr. Bashi Books
  • Format: Paperback, 63 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9780999002025

title: Handmade in Britain
author: Joanna Norman
description:
Handmade in Britain by Joanna Norman is an illustrated history of British decorative arts, drawing on objects held by London's Victoria & Albert Museum. It looks at ceramics, metalwork, woodwork, textiles and stained glass, and at celebrated makers such as Thomas Chippendale, William Morris, Josiah Wedgwood and Clarice Cliff.

The book follows Britain's journey from a modest importer of luxury goods in the Renaissance to a leading exporter of decorative work by the late 1800s, considering the social and cultural settings that shaped each craft. Contributions from contemporary makers including Edmund de Waal and Grayson Perry bring the story up to date, making it a fine choice for lovers of craft, design and museum collections.

  • Author: Joanna Norman
  • Publisher: Victoria & Albert Museum
  • Format: Hardcover, 176 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781851777082

title: Arabia: A Journey Through the Heart of the Middle East
sheet_title: Arabia- Journey Through the Heart of the Middle East
author: Levison Wood
description:
Arabia: A Journey Through the Heart of the Middle East is explorer Levison Wood's account of his most ambitious expedition yet, a journey around the whole of the Arabian Peninsula. Following in the tradition of travellers such as T. E. Lawrence and Wilfred Thesiger, he crosses some of the planet's toughest and loveliest terrain.

Along the way Wood sets out to challenge common perceptions of a much-misunderstood region, tracing how it has changed and seeking out the stories that rarely reach the news. Vivid and thoughtful, it suits armchair travellers and anyone wanting a more nuanced picture of the Middle East.

  • Author: Levison Wood
  • Publisher: Hodder & Stoughton
  • Format: Paperback, 354 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781473676305

title: Vintage Handbags
author: Marnie Fogg
description:
Vintage Handbags: Collecting and Wearing Designer Classics by fashion historian Marnie Fogg traces a hundred years of the handbag, following its story through the decades to the designer classics that collectors look for today.

The history is told through archive images, fashion photography and new photographs of rare bags, with guidance on collecting and wearing vintage bags. It is a stylish read for fashion lovers, collectors and anyone curious about the stories behind iconic designer bags.

  • Author: Marnie Fogg
  • Publisher: Welbeck
  • Format: Hardcover, 224 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781802790955

title: A-Maze-ing Places
description:
A-Maze-ing Places: Challenging Mazes for the Daydreaming Traveller is a hardback puzzle book from Allsorted, filled with mazes for anyone who dreams of faraway places.

As its subtitle promises, the mazes are designed to be challenging, making it a relaxing pastime for puzzle fans and armchair travellers and a fun gift for anyone who likes to escape into a good puzzle.

  • Publisher: Allsorted
  • Format: Hardcover
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781910562994

Large Print Puzzles: Crosswords (Volume 4) is a paperback collection of crossword puzzles printed in large type, so the clues and grids are easier to read.

It suits crossword fans who prefer bigger print, and is a handy book for relaxing, keeping the mind active and passing the time at home or on the move.

  • Language: English

  • ISBN: 9781838521905

Large Print Puzzles: Sudoku (Volume 4) is a paperback collection of sudoku puzzles printed in large, clear type for easier reading.

It suits number-puzzle fans who prefer bigger print, and makes a handy companion for unwinding, keeping the mind active and passing the time at home or while travelling.

  • Format: Paperback
  • Language: English
  • Series: Large Print Puzzles: Sudoku, Volume 4
  • ISBN: 9781838521899

author: Junzo Terada
description:
Magical Menagerie: 20 Punch-Out Animals for Play and Display is a craft book by the Japanese artist Junzo Terada, published by Chronicle Books. It holds twenty animals in Terada's distinctive artwork, ready to be pressed out of the pages.

Once punched out, the creatures can be played with or arranged on display, making it a charming hands-on project for children and adults who enjoy paper crafts and illustration.

  • Format: 20 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9780811870030

title: Dear Moon
author: Zayneb Haleem
description:
Dear Moon: Be Inspired by the Beautiful Wisdom of the Qur'an is a hardback book by Zayneb Haleem, published by Ebury Press. As its subtitle explains, it draws on the teachings of the Qur'an to offer readers inspiration and reflection.

It is a thoughtful choice for anyone seeking spiritual encouragement, and a gentle gift for friends and family.

  • Author: Zayneb Haleem
  • Publisher: Ebury Press
  • Format: Hardcover, 128 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781529932447

title: Usborne Book and Jigsaw Space Maze
sheet_title: Usborne Book and Jigsaw Space Maze
author: Sam Smith
description:
Usborne Book and Jigsaw: Space Maze is a gift pack by Sam Smith, illustrated by Fermín Solís, that pairs a jigsaw puzzle with a book of mazes. Once the colourful space-scene jigsaw is put together, it reveals a maze of its own to solve.

The accompanying 32-page book adds a whole set of extra mazes with a space theme for young puzzlers to work through, combining puzzle-building, problem solving and imaginative play in one pack.

  • Author: Sam Smith
  • Illustrator: Fermín Solís
  • Publisher: Usborne
  • Format: Book and jigsaw pack, 32-page book
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781801310925

title: The World’s Worst Parents
author: David Walliams
description:
The World's Worst Parents by David Walliams, illustrated in full colour by Tony Ross, brings together ten comic tales about the silliest, most outrageous mums and dads imaginable. It follows his collections The World's Worst Children and The World's Worst Teachers.

Readers meet characters such as Peter Pong, whose feet are the smelliest anywhere, the speed-obsessed Harriet Hurry, toy-grabbing Monty Monopolize and Supermum in her home-made costume. Packed with Walliams's trademark mischief and Ross's lively pictures, it is a laugh-out-loud collection for young readers and a fun choice for families to share.

  • Author: David Walliams
  • Illustrator: Tony Ross
  • Publisher: HarperCollins Children’s Books
  • Format: Hardcover, 312 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9780008305796

title: Alice's Adventures In Wonderland & Through The Looking-Glass
sheet_title: Alice's Adventures In Wonderland & Through The Looking-Glass
author: Lewis Carroll
description:
Alice's Adventures in Wonderland & Through the Looking-Glass by Lewis Carroll, in the Oxford Children's Classics series, brings together the two famous stories of Alice's dreamlike adventures. In the first, Alice follows the White Rabbit down a rabbit hole into Wonderland, where she meets the Cheshire Cat, the Mad Hatter and the Queen of Hearts.

In the second, she climbs through a mirror into a world laid out like a chessboard, meeting Tweedledum and Tweedledee and Humpty Dumpty on her way to becoming a queen. Playful, witty and full of nonsense verse, these timeless tales delight young readers and adults alike.

  • Author: Lewis Carroll
  • Publisher: Oxford University Press
  • Format: Paperback, 304 pages
  • Language: English
  • Series: Oxford Children's Classics
  • ISBN: 9780192789020

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description:
Frankenstein by Mary Shelley appears here in the Oxford Children's Classics series, introduced by Kiran Millwood Hargrave and backed up with reader insights, facts and activities. Victor Frankenstein becomes consumed by the idea of using electricity to create life, piecing together a body from stolen parts and jolting it into existence.

Appalled by what he has made, he abandons his creature, which, rejected and alone, turns towards revenge. This gripping gothic classic raises questions about ambition, responsibility and what it means to be human, and this accessible edition is a great way for younger readers to discover it.

  • Author: Mary Shelley
  • Introduction: Kiran Millwood Hargrave
  • Publisher: Oxford University Press
  • Format: Paperback, 288 pages
  • Language: English
  • Series: Oxford Children's Classics
  • ISBN: 9780192789129

title: Hansel and Gretel
author: Stephen King
description:
Hansel and Gretel is a retelling of the Brothers Grimm fairy tale by Stephen King, illustrated with artwork by Maurice Sendak, creator of Where the Wild Things Are. It follows two brave children who find themselves lost in a dark and perilous forest.

King brings his gift for suspense to the familiar story, and the book opens with a personal foreword by him. Produced with the support of the Maurice Sendak Foundation, this high-quality jacketed hardback is a treasure for admirers of both creators and of darker fairy tales.

  • Author: Stephen King
  • Illustrator: Maurice Sendak
  • Publisher: Hodder Children's Books
  • Format: Hardcover, 48 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781444919349

title: The Little Liar
author: Mitch Albom
description:
The Little Liar is a novel by Mitch Albom set during the Second World War. When the Nazis occupy the Greek city of Salonika, eleven-year-old Nico is given a chance to save his family by persuading his Jewish neighbours to board trains heading east, trusting the promise of work and safety.

Only when it is too late does he learn where those trains were really going. The novel also traces the lives of Nico's brother Sebastian, a girl from their school named Fanni, and the German officer who changed everything for them, following the fallout across the decades. A moving tale of truth and lies, survival, revenge and the redeeming power of love, it suits readers of historical fiction.

  • Author: Mitch Albom
  • Publisher: Sphere
  • Format: Paperback, 352 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9780751584608

title: The Chibineko Kitchen
author: Yuta Takahashi
description:
The Chibineko Kitchen by Yuta Takahashi, translated from the Japanese by Cat Anderson, is a gentle, magical novel and the first book in the Meals to Remember at the Chibineko Kitchen series. Mourning her brother, who died suddenly, Kotoko follows a river and a trail of white shells to a tiny restaurant beside the sea.

She has been told that a meal there can bring a lost loved one back, just once. When young chef Kai brings out the exact meal her brother once made for her, something extraordinary begins. Comforting and quietly moving, it is a perfect read for fans of cosy Japanese fiction about food, cats and memory.

  • Author: Yuta Takahashi
  • Translator: Cat Anderson
  • Publisher: John Murray
  • Format: Paperback, 208 pages
  • Language: English
  • Series: Meals to Remember at the Chibineko Kitchen, Book 1
  • ISBN: 9781399817615

title: Chasing Homer
author: László Krasznahorkai
description:
Chasing Homer is a breathless novella by the Hungarian writer László Krasznahorkai, translated by John Batki. A hunted man races across Europe and heads blindly south with assassins close behind, blending into crowds, crossing changing terrain and jumping on and off ferries to stay one step ahead of death.

Told in Krasznahorkai's famously long, propulsive sentences, the story lives entirely in the present moment, with no time for past or future. Conceived as a collaboration, the book pairs each of the nineteen chapters with a full-colour painting by Max Neumann, alongside music by percussionist Szilveszter Miklós. It is a striking choice for readers of adventurous literary fiction.

  • Author: László Krasznahorkai
  • Translator: John Batki
  • Artist: Max Neumann
  • Publisher: New Directions
  • Format: Hardcover, 96 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9780811227971

title: I, Robot
author: Isaac Asimov
description:
I, Robot is Isaac Asimov's classic collection of linked science fiction stories tracing the development of robots, from simple early machines to advanced minds that may one day surpass their makers. At their heart are the Three Laws of Robotics, the rules meant to keep robots obedient and protective of human life.

Asimov explores what happens when those laws meet real situations, with robots that malfunction, read minds, show a sense of humour and even take on political roles. Thought-provoking and inventive, these stories shaped how generations imagine robots and artificial intelligence, and remain essential reading for science fiction fans.

  • Author: Isaac Asimov
  • Publisher: Harper Voyager
  • Format: Paperback, 244 pages
  • Language: English
  • Series: Robot
  • ISBN: 9780008279554

title: Fahrenheit 451
author: Ray Bradbury
description:
Fahrenheit 451 is Ray Bradbury's classic novel of a future in which books are banned and firemen exist to burn them. Guy Montag is one of those firemen, yet he is quietly unhappy, his marriage is troubled, and he begins to wonder what the forbidden books might hold.

As his doubts grow, he becomes the quarry of the Mechanical Hound that hunts down anyone who dares to keep and read books. Often read alongside 1984 and Brave New World, this powerful, poetic novel explores censorship, conformity and the influence of mass media, and still feels startlingly relevant today.

  • Author: Ray Bradbury
  • Publisher: HarperVoyager
  • Format: Paperback, 227 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9780006546061

title: Mate
author: Ali Hazelwood
description:
Mate is Ali Hazelwood's paranormal romance and the second book in her Bride series. Serena Paris has no family and no pack, and she is one of a kind: the first known human-werewolf hybrid. Going public was meant to help heal a centuries-old rift between the species, but instead it makes her a target in the ruthless politics of werewolves, Vampyres and humans.

With enemies closing in, her one option is Koen Alexander, the commanding Alpha of the Northwest pack, who will let nothing stand in the way of protecting his mate, even if Serena does not share his feelings. Steamy, tense and shadowed by her past, it suits fans of romantasy and of Bride.

  • Author: Ali Hazelwood
  • Publisher: Sphere
  • Format: Paperback, 448 pages
  • Language: English
  • Series: Bride, Book 2
  • ISBN: 9781408722718

title: Lost Souls Meet Under a Full Moon
sheet_title: Lost Souls Meet Under a Full Moon
author: Mizuki Tsujimura
description:
Lost Souls Meet Under a Full Moon is a magical realism novel by Mizuki Tsujimura, translated from the Japanese by Yuki Tejima. At its centre is a go-between, a mysterious teenage boy named Ayumi Shibuya who can let the living see someone they have lost one more time.

His rules are strict: each reunion happens only once, the dead are free to decline, no fee is charged, and it can only happen on the night of a full moon. Through clients such as a resentful eldest son, a schoolgirl haunted by guilt over her best friend's death and a businessman searching for his missing fiancée, the novel explores grief, regret and the bonds that outlast loss.

  • Author: Mizuki Tsujimura
  • Translator: Yuki Tejima
  • Publisher: Penguin
  • Format: Paperback, 320 pages
  • Language: English
  • Series: Lost Souls, Book 1
  • ISBN: 9781804992616

title: The Little Instruction Book for Dog Parents
sheet_title: The Little Instruction Book for Dog Parents
author: Kate Freeman
description:
The Little Instruction Book for Dog Parents by Kate Freeman is a humorous, illustrated survival guide for anyone whose dog rules both the home and the heart. It starts from the premise that having a dog is a whole lifestyle rather than a decision.

With tongue-in-cheek advice on everything from food left unattended and a love of muddy puddles to the unforgivable crime of fussing over another animal, it pokes gentle fun at the quirks every owner knows. Small and charming, it makes an ideal gift for dog lovers.

  • Author: Kate Freeman
  • Publisher: Summersdale
  • Format: Hardcover, 96 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781837993642

title: Countdown to Riches
author: Rhonda Byrne
description:
Countdown to Riches: 21 Days of Wealth-Attracting Habits is by Rhonda Byrne, the author of The Secret and The Greatest Secret. Byrne argues that financial struggle begins in the mind, and that letting go of a scarcity mindset is the key to a richer life.

Over a 21-day programme, she shares simple daily practices designed to change your relationship with money, build habits that create and keep wealth, and offer wider insights into how life works. It suits readers drawn to the law of attraction and anyone looking for a positive, mindset-based approach to prosperity.

  • Author: Rhonda Byrne
  • Publisher: HarperOne
  • Format: Hardcover, 208 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9780063478626

title: The Awesome Activity & Puzzle Book
author: Eric Saunders
description:
The Awesome Activity & Puzzle Book by Eric Saunders is a 64-page collection of puzzles, colouring pages and other activities from Arcturus, designed to keep boredom at bay.

With content aimed at all ages, it is a fun way for every member of the family to fill a rainy afternoon, a long journey or a quiet hour together.

  • Author: Eric Saunders
  • Publisher: Arcturus
  • Format: Paperback, 64 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781398812628

title: Training Secrets of the World's Greatest Footballers
author: James Witts
description:
Training Secrets of the World's Greatest Footballers: How Science is Transforming the Modern Game by James Witts takes readers behind the scenes of elite football to show what it takes to compete at the very top.

Covering all aspects of the sport, it draws on insights from star players, coaches and sports scientists at clubs such as Bayern Munich, Barcelona, Chelsea, Real Madrid, Paris Saint-Germain and Manchester United, revealing how science helps the likes of Lionel Messi, Gareth Bale and Cristiano Ronaldo perform at their peak. Mixing dressing-room secrets with practical advice, it will interest players, coaches and fans alike.

  • Author: James Witts
  • Publisher: Bloomsbury Sport
  • Format: Paperback, 240 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781472948458

title: Friends: Framed Photo : With Sound!
author: Michelle Morgan
description:
Friends: Framed Photo: With Sound! is a mini kit by Michelle Morgan from the RP Minis range, celebrating the much-loved sitcom Friends. It features a small replica of the frame around the peephole of Monica's apartment door, which plays famous quotes from the show at the press of a button.

A 48-page mini book is included, making it a fun desk ornament and a perfect gift for fans of the series. The sound feature needs two AAA batteries, which are not included.

  • Author: Michelle Morgan
  • Publisher: Running Press (RP Minis)
  • Format: Mini kit with 48-page book
  • Language: English
  • Series: RP Minis
  • ISBN: 9780762484089

title: Shelf Life: Writers on Books & Reading
sheet_title: Shelf Life: Writers on Books & Reading
author: Alex Johnson
description:
Shelf Life: Writers on Books & Reading is an anthology edited by Alex Johnson, gathering essays, poems, lectures and commentary on the joys and troubles of loving books, written between the sixteenth and twentieth centuries.

Readers hear from a famous British prime minister on how best to shelve a library, an American president on what to read outdoors and a nineteenth-century philosopher on the psychology of reading, alongside lighter pieces on getting rid of unwanted volumes and keeping children away from a precious collection. Witty and affectionate, it is a delightful gift for any book lover.

  • Editor: Alex Johnson
  • Publisher: British Library Publishing
  • Format: Paperback, 128 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9780712352864

title: All or Nothing
author: Michael Wolff
description:
All or Nothing: How Trump Recaptured America is Michael Wolff's insider account of Donald Trump's 2024 presidential campaign, by the writer behind Fire and Fury. It covers a race marked by court cases, a pair of attempts on Trump's life and a late switch in his Democratic opponent.

Wolff tracks Trump's return to power as he takes on prosecutors, judges and rivals, while a split-screen reality unfolds: grave legal jeopardy on one side and surging political support on the other. Pacy and revealing, it suits readers who want a close-up view of the campaign and the forces behind its outcome.

  • Author: Michael Wolff
  • Publisher: Hachette
  • Format: Paperback, 400 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781408713952

title: How We Break
author: Vincent Deary
description:
How We Break: Navigating the Wear and Tear of Living is a book by psychologist Vincent Deary, published by Penguin. As its subtitle suggests, it looks at the strains that build up over the course of a life and at how we can find our way through them.

It suits readers interested in psychology and in understanding how people cope when life wears them down.

  • Author: Vincent Deary
  • Publisher: Penguin Books
  • Format: Paperback, 304 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9780141979793

title: The Phone Fix: How to Transform Your Smartphone Habits
sheet_title: The Phone Fix: How to Transform Your Smartphone Habits
author: Faye Begeti
description:
The Phone Fix: How to Transform Your Smartphone Habits is a science-based guide by Dr Faye Begeti, a neurologist and neuroscientist working in the NHS, to what really goes on in our brains when we reach for our phones. We check our devices dozens of times a day, but how much of the alarm about screens is actually true?

Begeti explains how habits around technology form, separating deliberate choices from automatic behaviour, and challenges popular myths about digital addiction, blue light and dopamine. Instead of a strict digital detox, she offers a practical, brain-friendly plan for building better habits and breaking unhelpful ones, ideal for anyone who wants a healthier relationship with their phone.

  • Author: Faye Begeti
  • Publisher: Apollo
  • Format: Paperback, 320 pages
  • Language: English
  • ISBN: 9781803285573
